name: template dual-momentum
code:
STRATEGY "Dual momentum core"
REBALANCE monthly
BENCHMARK SPY

IF return(QQQ, 126 days) > return(SPY, 126 days)
  IF return(QQQ, 126 days) > return(BIL, 126 days)
    WEIGHT equally
      BUY QQQ
  ELSE
    WEIGHT equally
      BUY BIL
  END
ELSE
  IF return(SPY, 126 days) > return(BIL, 126 days)
    WEIGHT equally
      BUY SPY
  ELSE
    WEIGHT equally
      BUY BIL
  END
END

name: template trend-filter
code:
STRATEGY "Trend filter Mag7"
REBALANCE weekly
BENCHMARK SPY

WEIGHT equally
  IF price(AAPL) > moving_average(AAPL, 100 days)
    BUY AAPL
  ELSE
    BUY BIL
  END
  IF price(MSFT) > moving_average(MSFT, 100 days)
    BUY MSFT
  ELSE
    BUY BIL
  END
  IF price(AMZN) > moving_average(AMZN, 100 days)
    BUY AMZN
  ELSE
    BUY BIL
  END
  IF price(GOOGL) > moving_average(GOOGL, 100 days)
    BUY GOOGL
  ELSE
    BUY BIL
  END
  IF price(META) > moving_average(META, 100 days)
    BUY META
  ELSE
    BUY BIL
  END
  IF price(NVDA) > moving_average(NVDA, 100 days)
    BUY NVDA
  ELSE
    BUY BIL
  END
  IF price(TSLA) > moving_average(TSLA, 100 days)
    BUY TSLA
  ELSE
    BUY BIL
  END
